Rich tactile detail but restrained residential finish, no damage. Uniform soft neutral diffuse illumination, albedo only. No directional highlights, baked shadows, perspective, vignette, objects, text or borders. Edge-to-edge seamless repeat. The surface must look organically nonuniform, never like identical stamped noise.
